column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MARRIAGE REGISTRATION ORDINANCE
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
1.  This Act may be cited as the Marriage Registration

2.
The Long title of the Marriage Registration Ordinance
No.  19  of  1907  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “principle
enactment”)  is  amended  to  remove  the  words  “OTHER
THAN THE MARRIAGES OF MUSLIMS AND” therein.

3.
In  the  Section  64  substitute  the  interpretation  of
marriage  contracted  under  this  ordinance  save  and  except
marriages  contracted  under  the  Kandyan  Marriage  and
Divorce Act or the Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act”.
